assumptions: García table rows are source-specific empirical operating points, not fitted channel physics.
A factor of seven is an explicit per-channel-flow scenario, not an accepted correction. Axial loss stays fixed while module flow scales.
Scale source and process membrane areas by parallel replication at unchanged per-element axial loss; fractional equivalent module count is a normalization.
Chiu figure constraint assumes nondecreasing critical flux and uses reading intervals to bracket, without interpolation through the transition or extrapolation.
Capacity fractions 1.0 and 0.8 are operating-policy scenarios; 0.8 is not a measured safety factor.
Source temperature and viscosity are unavailable. DWSIM uses the preserved 298.15 K pure-water property anchor, a conditional dilute-carrier approximation.
Passive-solute bookkeeping assumes rejection 1 and fixes module-inlet concentration by adjusting fresh concentration; no particle species or fouling law is implemented in DWSIM.

The original OpenLB-derived support resistance and fixed non-support impedance supply TMP. Crossflow criteria are common to the three support designs; no geometry-dependent fouling benefit is inferred.
Separate fresh-feed and circulation pumps retain the previous lumped upstream pressure-loss topology, with no resolved axial TMP field.
Lowest energy means lowest among solved admissible discrete points under a named policy, never a continuous or validated plant optimum.

recycle.tear_location: temperature-controlled module inlet after the cooler

assumptions: Synthetic pure-water steady-state scenario, nominal fixed 100 LMH and 1 m2; unchanged native OpenLB resistance ratios and common literature-informed non-support impedance.
Overall recovery is permeate/fresh-feed mass fraction. Module/permeate ratio is independent; it must exceed 1/recovery for a nonempty recycle.
Reference volumes are mass divided by fresh-feed density. Channel drop = R_channel times module reference flow: a constant-property linear hydraulic law, not a measured channel geometry.
Fresh-feed pump raises only fresh feed through TMP; circulation pump raises full module flow through the separate upstream channel drop.
The membrane chamber and return operate at external pressure plus TMP. Pressure loss is upstream of the chamber, not a resolved axial membrane pressure profile.
Purge and permeate discharge at fresh-feed pressure, without pressure-energy recovery; pure-water splitting does not predict solute rejection.

A stock cooler after the high-pressure mixer fixes circulation-inlet temperature to the reference value. Its heat removal is reported separately from pump shaft power; refrigeration electricity is not calculated.
Stock DWSIM recycle iterates a deliberately perturbed tear estimate; no custom convergence algorithm or replacement stock unit is implemented.
No fouling, osmosis, pump curves, motor losses, backwash, real material reconstruction or total-plant energy claim.

frederic2018_model.kind: Theoretical numerical comparison, not experimental fouling calibration
frederic2018_model.spatial_domain: 2D porous-membrane cross-section; channel wall pressure versus external permeate pressure; symmetry boundaries
frederic2018_model.axial_validity: Whole-module interpretation requires axial pressure loss negligible relative to TMP; otherwise represents a local axial slice.
frederic2018_model.selective_resistance_m_inv: e_m/K_m; preserve impedance when numerically thickening the selective region
frederic2018_model.fouling_law_as_supplied: dRc/dt = -A*(u dot n); A chosen arbitrarily; no local crossflow-velocity dependence
frederic2018_model.equation_audit: Supplied Markdown Eqs. 4 and 8 imply A=B1*B2, while following Eq. 9 prose states B2/B1. Preserve this discrepancy; check source typography before implementing. Do not silently transplant the coefficient.
frederic2018_model.reported_figures_role: Geometry, pressure/flux distribution and normalized fouling trends; not a measured Jcrit(u) relation.

extraction.scenario_scope: Nominal table comparison at the existing project target. No operating margin, new steady-state process, suspension properties or slurry DWSIM validation inferred.
unresolved_issues: Garcia Table 1 Q/u corresponds to roughly single-channel scale rather than the stated full seven-channel module; no factor correction accepted.
Chiu 2005 Fig. 3 borrowed critical-flux series differs in some velocity locations and one flux from Garcia Table 1; retain separate readings.
Garcia filtration viscosity/temperature and point-specific uncertainty unavailable; rheometer values are not substituted.
Original PDFs for these four sources absent; Markdown tables/equation typography can be audited later without requiring raw data or new experiments.

protocol.status: Specified before native simulations; retain failed cases and do not relax screens after observing results.

geometry.scope: Synthetic axisymmetric connected pore, same necks/interface region, body thickness and representative area; only interior radius changes. Both leads are numerical development sections and excluded from inferred body resistance. No reconstructed experimental specimen.

process.translation: Apply each measured body resistance / measured baseline body resistance to the published 3.12 m/h support impedance. One common baseline calibration; no design-specific fit. Use Zhu PDF-v2 effective non-support impedance and its reading range unchanged across designs. This is a literature-anchored scenario, not an absolute pore reconstruction or a viscosity-corrected experimental prediction.
process.scope: Transmembrane hydraulic-load shaft energy only. Constant inlet properties, linear flow, unchanged effective non-support impedance.
